description: NPY Artifact Schema for Phase 6 Data Pipeline

artifact_structure.data.npy: NumPy array containing preprocessed model input tensor (NCHW format)
artifact_structure.data.npy.metadata.json: JSON metadata file with full provenance information

model_sha256.description: Full SHA256 hash of the model file used for preprocessing

tensor_shape.description: Shape of the preprocessed tensor in NCHW format [batch, channels, height, width]

source_id.description: File path or identifier of the source

frame_index.description: Frame index (0 for image, 0..N for video)

original_width.description: Original width of the source frame in pixels

original_height.description: Original height of the source frame in pixels

color_space.description: Color space of the preprocessed tensor

scale_factor.description: Scale factor applied during resize (if applicable)

padding_applied.description: Padding applied as [top, bottom, left, right] (if applicable)

conversions.description: List of conversions applied in order (e.g., 'bgr_to_rgb', 'letterbox_resize_100x100_to_960x960')

validation_rules.model_id: Must match a registered model in ModelRegistry
validation_rules.model_sha256: Must match the actual SHA256 of the model file
validation_rules.preprocessing_version: Must match the current preprocessing version for the model
validation_rules.contract_version: Must match the model contract version
validation_rules.tensor_shape: Must exactly match the model's target_shape from contract
validation_rules.tensor_dtype: Must match the model's dtype from contract
validation_rules.color_space: Must match the model's color_space from contract
validation_rules.tensor_layout: Must match the model's tensor_layout from contract
validation_rules.resize_mode: Must match the model's resize_mode from contract
